policy.civil_time: birth wall-clock time is read as fixed UTC+9 (KST); historical Korean offsets (LMT +8:27:52 to 1908-04-01, UTC+8:30 1908-1911 and 1954-1961, DST 1948-1960 and 1987-1988) are NOT applied, only flagged as CIVIL_TIME_OFFSET alternatives
policy.month_pillar: 節 instants (absolute time); KASI table 2000-2027, Meeus computation outside
policy.day_and_hour_pillar: local mean solar time: KST + (longitude - 135) * 4 min; no equation of time
policy.unknown_birth_time: hour_pillar = null, never a guessed hour; the whole birth date is scanned and any differing year/month/day pillar set is returned as an alternative with certainty PARTIAL + BOUNDARY_REVIEW_REQUIRED

library_readme_discrepancy: korean-saju 0.3.0 README (dist-info METADATA, 'Saju.from_birth' example) prints 己巳 丙子 丙寅 癸巳 for 1990-01-01 09:00 KST at longitude 126.9784. The 0.3.0 source does not produce that: solar_time/solar_time_correction.py applies (longitude - KOREAN_STANDARD_MERIDIAN 135.0) * 4.0 min, so 09:00 KST becomes 08:27:55 and saju.from_birth returns hour 壬辰 (verified 2026-10-25 against the installed package). The README example is the no-correction value. Fateweave follows the code and an independent calculation (test_manse.independent_hour_pillar), not the README text.

independent_references.day_anchor: Wikipedia, 'Sexagenary cycle', section 'Sexagenary days': 1949-10-01 (Gregorian) is 甲子 (also 1912-02-18 甲子; the two anchors differ by a multiple of 60 days). Day index = (proleptic Gregorian ordinal - ordinal(1949-10-01)) mod 60, computed in the test with datetime.date.toordinal (JDN = ordinal + 1721425).
independent_references.solar_term_times: bebeyam.com '사주 만세력 YYYY년 24절기 절입시간' tables (KST, Seoul reference point), fetched 2026-10-25: https://bebeyam.com/사주-만세력-1989년-기사년-24절기-절입시간-입춘/ , https://bebeyam.com/사주-만세력-1990년-경오년-24절기-절입시간-입춘/ , https://bebeyam.com/사주-만세력-1994년-갑술년-24절기-절입시간-입춘/ . A private almanac site (not KASI); its times are KST.
independent_references.solar_term_dates: Hong Kong Observatory Gregorian-Lunar calendar conversion tables T1989c.txt, T1990c.txt, T1994c.txt (https://www.hko.gov.hk/tc/gts/time/calendar/text/files/), dates in HKT (UTC+8), fetched 2026-10-25
independent_references.kasi_note: KASI (astro.kasi.re.kr) does not expose pre-2000 solar term instants on a fetchable page; no KASI value was used for 1989/1990/1994.

cases.policy: manse-v1 (Seoul longitude assumed, local mean solar time correction)

source.year: 1990 立春 = 1990-02-04 11:14 KST (bebeyam 1990 table; HKO T1990c: 立春 1990-02-04). Birth precedes it, so the 立春-year is 1989 = 己巳 ((1989-4) mod 60 = 5).
source.month: 1989 大雪 = 1989-12-07 12:21 KST (bebeyam 1989; HKO T1989c: 大雪 1989-12-07) and 1990 小寒 = 1990-01-05 23:33 KST (bebeyam 1990; HKO T1990c: 小寒 1990-01-05). Birth lies between them, so 子 month; 五虎遁 for a 己 year starts 寅 at 丙寅, so 子 = 丙子.
source.hour: 09:00 KST at 126.9784E = 08:27:55 local mean time, 辰時 (07-09). 五鼠遁 for a 丙 day starts 子 at 戊子, so 辰 = 壬辰.

cases.notes: The plan's original 癸巳 (and the korean-saju README example) is the NO-correction value (09:00 read as 巳時 09-11). Under manse-v1's longitude correction the hour is 壬辰; confirmed as intended behaviour by the user in R1 review (2026-10-25) and the plan was corrected. Library computed-term deviation vs bebeyam: 小寒 23:30:41 vs 23:33, 立春 11:10:44 vs 11:14, 大雪 12:18:34 vs 12:21 KST (about 3-4 min early).

cases.policy: manse-v1 (Seoul longitude, local mean solar time correction)

source.hour: 09:35 KST at 126.9784E = 09:02:55 local mean time, 巳時 (09-11). 五鼠遁 for a 丙 day starts 子 at 戊子, so 巳 = 癸巳.

cases.notes: Shows where 癸巳 starts under manse-v1: the 辰/巳 boundary for Seoul is 09:32:05 KST (09:00 local mean time). 09:32 KST -> 08:59:55 -> 壬辰; 09:33 KST -> 09:00:55 -> 癸巳.

cases.policy: manse-v1 (yaja-si separated: AST 23:00-24:00 keeps the same calendar day; hour stem from next day)

source.month: 1994 清明 = 1994-04-05 09:32 KST, 立夏 = 1994-05-06 02:54 KST (bebeyam 1994; HKO T1994c: 清明 04-05, 立夏 05-06): 辰 month; 甲 year 五虎遁 丙寅 → 辰 = 戊辰.
source.hour: 23:40 KST at 126.9784E = 23:07:55 local mean time, 子時 (yaja-si). Hour stem uses the next day's stem 乙: 乙庚 → 丙子.

cases.notes: Separated yaja-si keeps 甲申 for the day; the unified (single 子時) school moves the day to 乙酉. Hour pillar 丙子 in both.
